scores.tell: Soft, outline-free edges fit, but the DJ deck is dense with small knobs and buttons, so it has many tiny edges.
Thin dark contour on the chair's metal legs and a crisp rim on the backrest. The shadow edge is a bit hard. The linework is finer than on real cards.
Fur edges are soft and there is no outline. The fine whiskers and the dense fur rim add more edge detail than real cards have.
none; clean soft facets, no outline, and crisp edges only at the gem and the highlights.
The truss has many thin dark lines, and the light beam edges are blurry and ghosted. Both are unlike the real cards.
Fairly clean edges with no outline. The dark slat grooves on the louvers are slightly thick and the door panel gaps are crisp.
Many fine edges on the water and the wood planks. The mask outline is darker and thinner, with an uneven soft glassy edge.
Edges are clean and soft with no outline. Only the plank seams in the floor are a little thin.
none; smooth rounded forms, crisp but soft edges, no outline, and a quiet background.
The background is full of fine grass blades and foliage edges. The checker squares and stone seams are thin and crisp. The scene has more edge density than the real cards.
